description: The bar chart illustrates the number of samples across seven distinct reasoning categories, with the vertical axis representing the "Number of Samples" on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10² to 10⁴, and the horizontal axis listing the reasoning types. The tallest bar corresponds to "Mathematical Reasoning," with 7,025 samples, followed by "General Reasoning" with 1,709 samples. "Natural Scene Reasoning" has 413 samples, "Physical Reasoning" has 232, "Logical Puzzle Reasoning" has 91, and "Chemical Reasoning" has the fewest samples at 49. The bars are arranged in descending order of sample count from left to right, and all are colored light blue.
